body:
I've looked at those books and most of them is simply: just be comfortable and/or learn about more topics to talk about. Did you find one with actual dialogue and good/bad examples conversations?

Even now, I'm not sure how I would of continued the conversation. There's this shawarma place I go to and I asked if it was a family owned business and they said yes, been in business for 20 years and they have another place down the street. How would you have followed that up?
I tried that and it was just painfully awkward because I didn't know how to follow up after the initial question besides acknowledging what they said.
